items.description:
US President Donald Trump has long revelled in the pomp and ceremony of international summitry but has often come away with little to show for his signature brand of personalised diplomacy.
His meeting on Thursday with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin has starkly exposed the limits of that approach, analysts said.
